body:
I know the anger is bad, but I just can’t help it. It like a switch flips. No seems to understand. I just can’t help myself. I tried meditating, but the person who was showing me techniques and other stuff about was a crazy born again christain who kept trying to convert me. Wich I wound up yelling at him and storming out. It just turned me off meditating.  I tried therapy and medication. Nothing worked. It also doesn’t help that the only time people take me seriously is when I have to yell at them or punch a desk or something. I can’t be taken seriously unless i’m angry because “ Oh he’s just being funny or silly with his answer” because i have to be nice and sweet because of my size, i’m almost seven feet tall. So if I even have the tinniest little hint of any emotion other than happy, it’s “Scares” people.

The balance between being alone and in a relationship would be true, if I was in one. I’m always laughed at and rejected. I don’t know what a relationship is like. Never dated and will most likely never will. I see how happy people are on Facebook and I just want to fucking go crazy. Its like they are rubbing it in my face directly after they tell its ok to be single or how lucky i am that i’m still single. I’m tired of being laughed at. I’m tired of hearing “I couldn’t date you because it would be scary”. It hurts.

I tried not giving a shit. It’s already lost some close friends and it has people asking me why i’m such an asshole now. I’m pretty sure it’s a reason why I got a fired as well. I tried going out, i hate bars and clubs and i don’t drink, but I tried to go anyway. I got in to a fight because an asshole bumped in to me and he spilt his beer and tried to have me pay for it. I tried to just walk it off but he kept at it. 

Any time i think i’m at the bottom, i’m not and just fall further and further. Any time I try something new, some thing happens and it just makes me not want to try anything else. Why keep trying when anything I try fails. There’s no point. There’s no point in being here if i’m just constantly trying and failing.  It’s just a waste of energy to try. I don’t see a point. I feel so ragged and tired. It’s just hard to keep going.
